title: Build a landing page with AI Studio
blurb: Describe your business and get a working page in minutes.

steps.title: Open AI Studio
steps.body: Click **AI Studio** in the left menu.

steps.title: Describe the page
steps.body: In the box, write something like: "A landing page for a Hamilton electrician. Big call button, list of services, quote form, navy and yellow." Then send it.
steps.tip: Attach your logo and a couple of job photos for a more on-brand result.

steps.title: Let it build
steps.body: AI plans and builds the page. Watch the preview fill in on the right.

steps.title: Check it on a phone
steps.body: Switch the preview between desktop, tablet and mobile. Most of your visitors will be on a phone.

steps.title: Ask for changes
steps.body: Type changes in plain words: "make the heading shorter", "add a reviews section". Keep asking until it looks right.

steps.title: Next
steps.body: Happy with it? Try **Publish your AI Studio site** from the Guide.
